description.title: תביעת סיעוד - כללית מושלם
description.summary: This table outlines the process for claiming nursing care benefits under the Clalit Mushlam policy. It details how Harel assesses continued eligibility for claims approved for 3 months or less.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את תהליך הגשת תביעת סיעוד במסגרת פוליסת "כללית מושלם". במקרה של אישור תביעה לתקופה של שלושה חודשים או פחות, המבוטח נדרש לספק מידע מפורט על מצבו הרפואי והתפקודי לקראת סיום התקופה המאושרת. חברת הראל תקבע את אחריותה בהתאם למידע הרפואי שיימסר, ובמידת הצורך, באמצעות בדיקה של המבוטח על ידי גורם מקצועי מטעמה. הפוליסה רלוונטית ל"כללית מושלם" ולתביעות סיעוד.
description.row_axis: Claim review process for short-term approvals
description.column_axis: Conditions and procedures for claim continuation

sketch:
A claim approved for a period of 3 months or less
In the event that a periodic claim is approved for a period of 3 months or less, and the insured believes that his medical and functional condition constitutes a justifcation for approval the claim for additional periods, towards the end of the period approved for payment the insured shall provide Harel with detailed information about his/her current condition.
Harel will determine its liability in accordance with the medical information provided by the insured and, if necessary, by way of examination of the insured by a professional on behalf of the company.

This table outlines the process for claiming nursing care benefits under the Clalit Mushlam policy. It details how Harel assesses continued eligibility for claims approved for 3 months or less.
ממדים: Claim review process for short-term approvals, Conditions and procedures for claim continuation

A claim approved for a period of 3 months or less
In the event that a periodic claim is approved for a period of 3 months or less, and the insured believes that his medical and functional condition constitutes a justifcation for approval the claim for additional periods, towards the end of the period approved for payment the insured shall provide Harel with detailed information about his/her current condition.
Harel will determine its liability in accordance with the medical information provided by the insured and, if necessary, by way of examination of the insured by a professional on behalf of the company.
